content_of_post_to_comment: We really do need to address disorder and antisocial behavior in our cities and on our transit systems. Selfishly, I don't enjoy feeling tense or stressed when I walk outside or board a train, but this is also about the rights of children to enjoy safe, comfortable places.
comment: The difficult question is how cities restore a sense of safety without confusing visibility of poverty, mental illness, or homelessness with disorder itself. The distinction shapes the solutions we choose.
